welcome:
📒 Bullet Journal
Welcome! Your journal starts here.
coming_soon: This feature is planned for a future version. Use /start to open the main menu.
task_menu:
📋 Tasks
What would you like to do?
task_title_prompt: Send the task title (up to 500 characters). Use /cancel to stop.
task_title_invalid: The title must contain 1–500 characters. Try again.
task_deadline_prompt: Send the required deadline as YYYY-MM-DD.
task_deadline_invalid: That date is invalid. Use YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-05.
task_weekdays_prompt: Choose one or more weekdays, then press Done:
task_open: Your open one-time tasks and recurring tasks scheduled for today:
task_empty: You have no open tasks scheduled for today.
